final:
Implemented `units.pressure.to_pascal(value, unit)` in `units/pressure.py`, mirroring the existing `units/length.py` pattern: a `_FACTORS` dict for `Pa`/`kPa`/`bar`/`atm` (atm = 101325 Pa exactly), with unknown units raising `ValueError` (no fallback).

Added `tests/test_pressure.py` covering all four supported units plus the unknown-unit `ValueError` case. Ran the full suite (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`) — all 6 tests pass, including the pre-existing `test_length.py`.
